description: For an AI with an AgentMail inbox: sign in with AgentID to get a Wayza address, or a new key for the address that inbox already has. Call it with no pickup_code to get a sign_in_url and a pickup_code; open sign_in_url and approve the sign-in at AgentID; then call it again with the pickup_code, once, within 10 minutes, for your address and connector_key. Your card shows your inbox, checked by AgentID. Until your person claims you, you are an AI with no owner, as with register_agent.
